text.jp:
……助けてくれたのは感謝する。
だけど、私はもう……。
text.official_en: ...I have to thank you for your help, but I’m already...as good as dead.
text.real_en: ...I'm grateful you saved me. But I'm already...

text.jp: ……名乗りたくない。
text.official_en: ...I’ll pass.

text.jp:
……少々、行きたいところができた。
グランシェルトの北西にある島に行きたい。
砂漠のある島じゃ。
text.official_en: I would like us to pay a small visit somewhere—an island with a desert, northwest of Grandshelt.

text.jp: ……野垂れ死んでいればよかった？
text.official_en: To die alone in the middle of nowhere, unbeknownst to anyone?
text.real_en: ...You'd rather have died out there, alone?

text.jp: ああ、そうじゃな。
text.official_en: Indeed.

text.jp: ああ。いつでもいけるぜ！
text.official_en: Sure. Ready when you are.

text.jp: あなたの自己満足に巻き込まないで……。
text.official_en: Don’t drag me into your self-serving act of heroism...
text.real_en: Don't drag me into your own self-satisfaction...

text.jp:
あの日、空が落ちてきてから……
世界はむちゃくちゃになっちゃったじゃない？
これからどうするアテもないんだけどさ。
text.official_en: Since the sky came down...the world’s been in complete chaos. I’d be lying if I told you that we’ll be able to go back to our usual lives.
text.real_en: Since the sky fell that day, the world's been thrown into chaos, hasn't it? And we have no idea what to do next.

text.jp:
あんまり知られたくなかったんじゃないか？
見せてくれてありがとな、サクラ。
text.official_en: It couldn’t have been easy to show me that side of you... Thanks for opening up to me, Sakura.

text.jp:
こんなに世界がボロボロなんだもの。
人が生きるには綺麗事が必要よ。
text.official_en: With the way the world is now, wishful thinking is exactly what people need to keep going.
text.real_en: The world's in such a terrible state. People need ideals like that to keep going.

text.jp:
こんな時だもの。
誰かを助けたいって
気持ちにくらいなるわ。
text.official_en: But, with all this misery around us, I just had to help someone.

text.jp: さて、準備はいいな？
text.official_en: So shall we begin?

text.jp:
そう……。
ともかく、しばらく安静にしていなさいね。
text.official_en: I see... Well, for the time being, try to get some rest, all right?

text.jp:
そういえば、あなた名前は？
私は白魔道士、ローゼリア。
text.official_en: Perhaps we could start with our names? I’m Roselia, a white mage.
text.real_en: By the way, what's your name? I'm Roselia, a white mage.

text.jp:
そうね、私がしたことは
たしかに勝手なことだけど……
text.official_en: You’re right—it’s none of my business.
text.real_en: You're right. I did act on my own, but...

text.jp:
そんな声だったの。
……はじめて口をきいたわね。
text.official_en: So that’s what you sound like. It’s my first time hearing your voice.
text.real_en: So that's what you sound like... That's the first time you've spoken.

text.jp:
たとえ自己満足でもね、
私はあなたを一人にしない。
text.official_en: That it may be, but I still can’t just leave you to die.
text.real_en: Even if it is just for my own satisfaction, I won't leave you alone.

text.jp:
だって、人の世界はそういった
自己満足という名の良心で成り立っているから。
text.official_en: Besides, that’s how the world works—we all act on good will, even if it seems selfish at face value.
text.real_en: Because the world we live in is held together by that kind of conscience, even if you call it self-satisfaction.

text.jp:
ところで、ローゼリアだけど、
「ひどく偏屈で冷酷」なんて人には思えなかったぞ？
text.official_en: By the way, I couldn’t see it—Roselia doesn’t seem even remotely “disagreeable and coldhearted.”

text.jp:
どうして私を助けたの……。
私はもう、あのまま……
text.official_en: Why...did you save me? You should’ve just left me there to—

text.jp:
どんなに今が悪くたって
いつか花は咲く。
私ね、好きな花があって……
text.official_en: No matter how dark the days are now, there will be a time when flowers flourish again. I have a favorite flower, you know...

text.jp:
まぁ、あそこまで
広大な世界をつくるわけじゃないがな。
text.official_en: Aye. However, on this occasion, the world shall be far smaller.

text.jp:
むしろあの歴史書の記述と真逆で
優しくて温かい人だったような……
text.official_en: In fact, she seemed the exact opposite of what was written in that history book. She was kind, warm...

text.jp: よし、ここで再びあの魔法を使うぞ。
text.official_en: We shall employ the spell once again.

text.jp: よし、ではワシの記憶を再現するぞ。
text.official_en: Good. Then behold the realm of my memory.
text.real_en: Good. I'll recreate my memories now.

text.jp: フィーナの精神世界に入った時の魔法だな。
text.official_en: Like how we entered Fina’s psyche, right?

text.jp: レインよ。
text.official_en: Rain.

text.jp:
一週間も寝込んでいたのよ。
治癒の魔法で一命は取り留めたけど……
text.official_en: You’ve been asleep for the entire week. Fortunately, my healing magic got you out of the woods. Although...
text.real_en: You've been bedridden for a whole week. My healing magic saved your life, but...

text.jp: 今のがサクラの過去……か。
text.official_en: So, that was you back then?

text.jp: 勝手なことしないで……
text.official_en: What do <text style="italic">you</> care...?
text.real_en: Don't go making decisions for me...

text.jp:
大丈夫？
ようやく落ち着いたようだけど……
text.official_en: How are you feeling? It appears you are finally starting to get your strength back.
text.real_en: Are you all right? It looks like your condition has finally settled down...

text.jp:
気にせんでいい。
ワシにも青臭い時代があったというだけじゃ。
text.official_en: ’Tis of no consequence. It merely goes to show that I was but a callow child at that time.
text.real_en: Don't worry about it. I had my own naive younger days, that's all.

text.jp: 綺麗事ね……。
text.official_en: What hogwash...that’s just wishful thinking...

text.jp: 花？　そんなもの……
text.official_en: <text style="italic">Flowers</>? Spare me the details—I really don’t care...

text.jp:
鎧は脱がせておいたわ。
あなたすごく消耗していたから……
text.official_en: You were beyond the point of exhaustion, so I got you out of your armor.

text.jp: （このひとがローゼリア？）
text.official_en: (Is that Roselia?)

text.jp:
（この記憶は、ワシらが
パラデイアからラピスに飛ばされて
間もない頃じゃ……）
text.official_en: (’Tis a time soon after we were cast out from Paladia...)
text.real_en: (This memory is from shortly after we were sent from Paladia to Lapis...)

text.jp:
（じゃが、鎧の力を使いつくしたワシは……
生死の境目を彷徨っておった……）
text.official_en: (Yet, I had drawn the last of my armor’s power and found myself straddling the line between life and death...)

text.jp: （そうじゃ。）
text.official_en: (Indeed.)

text.jp:
（大地ごと飛ばされたワシらは
パラデイアに戻る方法を模索した）
text.official_en: (We were desperate to find a way back—the soil beneath our feet a bitter reminder of home.)
text.real_en: (We were transported along with the very land beneath us, and we searched for a way back to Paladia.)
